e.title: trikit
e.summary: Pythonic 精算准备金（13★，MIT，PyPI）：Pandas 继承三角形 + Chain Ladder/Mack/Bootstrap
e.summary_en: Pythonic actuarial reserving (13★, MIT, PyPI): Pandas-inherited triangles + Chain Ladder/Mack/Bootstrap
e.summary_hk: Pythonic 精算準備金（13★，MIT，PyPI）：Pandas 繼承三角形 + Chain Ladder/Mack/Bootstrap
e.body: trikit（James D. Triveri，13★，MIT，PyPI 0.3.7）是 Python 损失准备金工具集：IncrTriangle/CumTriangle 直接继承 Pandas DataFrame（全部 Pandas 方法可用）、BaseChainLadder/MackChainLadder/BootstrapChainLadder 准备金估计与变异性量化。对 RIAA：Pythonic 准备金实现——[[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）之外的另一选择；Pandas 继承设计让数据操作自然（与 [[bermuda-ledger]] 的 Cell/Triangle 设计对照）；2023 停更但成熟；与 [[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 配套；适合准备金方向的 Python 工作流。
e.body_en: trikit (James D. Triveri, 13★, MIT, PyPI 0.3.7) is a Python loss reserving toolkit: IncrTriangle/CumTriangle inherit directly from Pandas DataFrame (all familiar Pandas methods available), BaseChainLadder/MackChainLadder/BootstrapChainLadder reserve estimates with variability quantification. For RIAA: a Pythonic reserving implementation — an alternative to [[chainladder-python]] (CAS official); the Pandas-inheritance design makes data operations natural (contrast with [[bermuda-ledger]]'s Cell/Triangle design); not updated since 2023 but mature; pairs with [[reservingmodels]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]; suits Python workflows in reserving.
e.body_hk: trikit（James D. Triveri，13★，MIT，PyPI 0.3.7）是 Python 損失準備金工具集：IncrTriangle/CumTriangle 直接繼承 Pandas DataFrame（全部 Pandas 方法可用）、BaseChainLadder/MackChainLadder/BootstrapChainLadder 準備金估計與變異性量化。對 RIAA：Pythonic 準備金實現——[[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）之外的另一選擇；Pandas 繼承設計讓數據操作自然（與 [[bermuda-ledger]] 的 Cell/Triangle 設計對照）；2023 停更但成熟；與 [[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 配套；適合準備金方向的 Python 工作流。
